description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviations - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1797/27 adding "The Development of Bandaranaike International Airport, Colombo etc.
categorisation: This gazette content is an order amending a schedule under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It involves regulatory changes to airport operations and maintenance, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the amendment of existing regulations through statutory authority.
